name: TeamStarWolf - ConnectWise Cloud Backup Compromise October 2026 Case Study
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. Enterprise ATT&CK v20.0 techniques bound in the ConnectWise Cloud Backup compromise case study, from Storm-0940's 10 to 14 October 2026 password spray through the 15 October sign-ins as ConnectWise's multi-tenant Microsoft 365 apps, the role self-assignment and the secrets planted on other apps, to the Graph and Key Vault activity Microsoft reported on 21 October. Score 100: Microsoft lists the technique id for this activity and a primary describes the dated behavior. Score 60: a primary describes the behavior and the id is the study's own mapping (T1110.003 only). Scores measure the strength of the tie to this record, not severity. Each technique appears under every tactic ATT&CK gives it. Comments carry the study's source numbers.
